description: Implementation of the FrameRate plugin class for managing display frame rate settings, collection, and notifications within the WPEFramework. Includes methods for starting/stopping FPS collection, setting/getting frame modes, and handling IARM events for display frame rate changes.

classes.name: FrameRate
classes.description: A plugin class managing display frame rate collection, configuration, and event notifications within WPEFramework.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, including IARM setup.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and deinitializes the plugin.

methods.name: setCollectionFrequencyWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for setting the FPS collection interval.

methods.name: startFpsCollectionWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to start FPS collection.

methods.name: stopFpsCollectionWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to stop FPS collection.

methods.name: updateFpsWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to update FPS value.

methods.name: setFrmMode
methods.description: Sets the frame mode via device interface.

methods.name: getFrmMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current frame mode.

methods.name: setDisplayFrameRate
methods.description: Sets the display frame rate.

methods.name: getDisplayFrameRate
methods.description: Gets the current display frame rate.

methods.name: getCollectionFrequency
methods.description: Returns the FPS collection interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: setCollectionFrequency
methods.description: Sets the FPS collection interval.

methods.name: startFpsCollection
methods.description: Starts FPS collection timer and data gathering.

methods.name: stopFpsCollection
methods.description: Stops FPS collection timer and reports data.

methods.name: updateFps
methods.description: Updates FPS statistics with a new value.

methods.name: fpsCollectionUpdate
methods.description: Sends FPS collection data as notification.

methods.name: onReportFpsTimer
methods.description: Timer callback to report FPS statistics periodically.

methods.name: FrameRatePreChange
methods.description: Static callback for pre-change event, notifies listeners.

methods.name: frameRatePreChange
methods.description: Notifies about display frame rate pre-change.

methods.name: FrameRatePostChange
methods.description: Static callback for post-change event, notifies listeners.

methods.name: frameRatePostChange
methods.description: Notifies about display frame rate post-change.
